subject: 24-hr doorbuster: Milwaukee M18 XC5.0 4-pack $419.96 (was $836)
summary: ToolNut's 24-hour doorbuster has the Milwaukee M18 REDLITHIUM XC5.0 4-pack at $419.96 against an $836 compare-at price, ending 3 AM ET Nov 23.
body: Flash sale: ToolNut has the Milwaukee M18 REDLITHIUM XC5.0 oil and solvent resistant battery 4-pack (48-11-1850R) at $419.96. ToolNut's compare-at price is $836, so that's about half off. It ends 3 AM ET on Nov 23 (2 AM CT), while supplies last.
That works out to about $105 a battery. The 2-pack on the same site is $209.98, so the 4-pack is the same per-battery price. Only grab it if you're already on M18.
ToolNut says it'll run a new doorbuster every day through Black Friday. Every deal we track is at offthetruckhq.com.
